job.name: ig45_host
job.style: Photorealistic cinematic still, warm golden-hour colours, true-to-life skin texture, shallow depth of field, filmed on a good camera. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.
job.style_qa: фотореализм, состоятельный мужчина ~55 на террасе виллы у моря на закате, смотрит в камеру, губы приоткрыты, без надписей и логотипов
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary man (not a celebrity), looks genuinely real.
job.meaning: ведущий ~55, загар, седая короткая борода, белая льняная рубашка, часы, терраса виллы над морем на закате
job.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photorealistic frame like a selfie-style talking video. A wealthy but kind Russian man about 55 with short salt-and-pepper hair, a neatly trimmed grey beard, deep tan, warm brown eyes, wearing an open-collar white linen shirt with rolled sleeves and an elegant steel wristwatch. He sits relaxed in a rattan lounge chair on the stone terrace of a luxury villa above the sea at golden hour, looking straight into the camera, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, calm wise confident expression, NO big smile. Medium shot from the chest up, both shoulders inside the frame, face large and sharp, top of head about 14% below the upper edge. Background: turquoise sea, white villa columns, potted olive tree and warm sunset light, softly blurred. Real camera frame, NOT CGI. No text, no logos, no watermark.
